title: Replication stopped after duplicate-key error
root_cause: The MariaDB SQL replication thread stopped while applying a transaction that conflicted with an existing row.
resolution: Review the conflicting transaction and affected row.
Correct the data inconsistency using the approved DBA procedure.
Resume replication only after the inconsistency is understood.
verification: Confirm Seconds_Behind_Master returns to an expected value.

title: Streaming service failure caused by full filesystem
root_cause: The streaming server filesystem became full and prevented the service from writing required files.
resolution: Review logs and temporary files using the approved cleanup procedure.
Restart the affected service only after operator approval.
verification: Confirm disk usage returned below the warning threshold.

title: Consumer backlog caused by database connection exhaustion
root_cause: Consumer workers exhausted the available MariaDB connections. Messages accumulated in Kafka while workers waited for database connections.
resolution: Review the connection pool configured for each consumer worker.
Reduce excessive per-worker database connection usage where appropriate.
Review MariaDB max_connections against expected workload.
Recycle affected consumers only after configuration review and operator approval.
verification: Confirm database connection utilization returns to a safe level.
Confirm Kafka consumer lag begins decreasing.

title: Debezium connector task failure
symptoms: Kafka consumer had no new events
root_cause: The Debezium connector task failed and stopped publishing new change events.
resolution: Correct the underlying connector or source issue.
Restart the connector only after operator approval.
verification: Confirm new CDC events appear in Kafka.
